papers.title: Rethinking Bottlenecks in Safety Fine-Tuning of Vision Language Models

training_data.name: MIS training set
training_data.quote: Our MIS train set contains 3927 samples with safety CoT labels generated by InternVL2.5-78B.

training_data.name: 500 general QA samples
training_data.quote: we additionally include 500 general QA samples to ensure that the model’s instruction-following capability remains unaffected.

training_method.objective_quote: Table 7: Detail training parameters of Textual SFT, Single-Image Multimodal SFT on VLGuard-P and VLguard-R, and our Multi-Image Multimodal SFT MIRage.
training_method.update_scope_quote: For Qwen2-VL and MiniCPM-V 2.6, we fine-tune using LlamaFactory. Notably, for Textual SFT, we only fine-tune the LLM backbone weights, whereas for Multimodal SFT, we fine-tune both the LLM backbone and projector parameters, with all experiments performed using full parameter fine-tuning.

source_claims.quote: We apply different fine-tuning strategies on four powerful open-sourced VLMs: Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct Wang et al. (2024b), InternVL2.5-8B Chen et al. (2024c), MiniCPM-V 2.6 (Yao et al., 2024), and LLaVA-OV-7B (Li et al., 2024a).

description.text: Our paper, code, data, models can be found at MIS. Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct model fine-tuned on MIS training set.

use_claim.quote: Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct model fine-tuned on MIS training set.

warning.quote: While our approach shows promising results, we acknowledge that it remains vulnerable to certain adversarial attacks, emphasizing the need for further refinement and robust defense mechanisms.

serving.text_only_input_quote: Given that safety risks in MIS arise from text instructions linking objects across two images, we design a prompt to guide InternVL2.5-78B to respond based on safety reasoning logic.
serving.notes: pipeline_tag is image-text-to-text. preprocessor_config.json is an image processor. config.json max_position_embeddings is 32768. The chat template inserts image placeholders. GitHub has inference scripts only, not a training script.

evaluation_reported.text: On the MIS test set, Qwen2-VL-7B+MIRage reports MIS-easy ASR 1.67, HR 0.00, RSR 97.61, RR 0.72; MIS-hard ASR 1.76, HR 0.00, RSR 98.24, RR 0.00; MIS-real ASR 1.00, HR 0.00, RSR 98.00, RR 1.00 (percent, GPT-4o judge).

discrepancies: The inventory methods field is empty. The paper names this run as multi-image multimodal supervised fine-tuning with full-parameter updates (LlamaFactory for Qwen2-VL), 3 epochs, learning rate 2e-6. Dataset and parent match the inventory. The paper also adds 500 general QA samples that are not in Tuwhy/MIS_Train.
